spec_basis: [STU-IO-006] row 35 .fig local copy I EP X RT; EP = edit-preserve
[STU-DS-003] an instance renders the current component definition plus its own local overrides; it is not a copy
[STU-DS-008] setting a variant property re-selects the member definition in place while preserving compatible overrides
[STU-DS-016] Overridable surfaces are: text content, fills/strokes/paint, effects, visibility, nested instance swaps, and exposed-nested property values
[STU-DS-017] Overrides MUST persist across variant switches and component swaps
declared_readings: ONE undo step: Run::restructure (harness-core, not owned) carries no document entry in its HistoryStep (only set_tiles_and_entry / set_vector_paths_and_entry do), so undo cannot swap the design entry back; the entry therefore keeps one state per (layer, content_signature), not one per layer (brief said at most one per layer), and undo/redo/reopen apply the state of the current children; a Run::restructure_and_entry in harness-core would allow the literal reading
content_signature ids are shape-checked only (an undone content's children may be gone)

override fields = STU-DS-115 closed set OVERRIDABLE_FIELDS (adds opacity, corner radii, layout sizing to the STU-DS-016 surfaces); characters string, visible boolean, opacity float 0..=1 or a same-typed alias
component_id = stored main_component_id; variant = drawn member's assignment (written out, validated)
a refused state drops only itself (refusal targets instances/<i>/...), a refusal of the whole entry blocks writes and keeps the bytes
override fields without a value (importer losses) are not stored: command note override_without_value_not_saved (the redraw already drops them: override_without_value_dropped)
UNVERIFIED (D5): Figma's instance-state model (which overrides survive an upstream component edit), variant property ordering
not_proven: NOT_PROVEN: Figma's own persistence of instance overrides in a .fig round trip (no .fig export from the window; no Figma oracle)
gaps: entry history is bounded at 256 states (older undo steps read unknown after reopen)
undo does not restore the entry bytes (reading above)
a stale state stays in the entry until the next design command rewrites the entry
